name: Cosmos no Sora ni
source:
Time of school festival. While most students are eager to show their spirits, main character who lost his memory in the childhood pays all his attention to five girls with scars on their hearts. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
正值学园祭。大多数学生都热情高涨，幼年时失去记忆的主人公，却把全部注意力放在五名心中留有伤痕的少女身上。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
